content:
One of my favourite Apple TV 4K features — the screensavers — is reportedly set to gain audio in tvOS 27. Here's what we know so far.

tvOS 27 code suggests at least one Apple TV screensaver will get audio options, with more likely to follow

October is shaping up to be a big month for Apple, with a slew of new hardware and software products expected to debut.

In addition to the rumoured new Apple TV 4K, a leaked image from Apple's internal code surfaced earlier today.

On the software side, leaker pdfu just published evidence pulled from tvOS 27 code showing at least one Apple TV screensaver gaining audio support.

As seen in the video above, the Snoopy screensaver hides a hidden option to enable or disable audio, or use a "reduce" setting.

The Snoopy screensaver example doesn't look like it will be too distracting, but I'm glad Apple plans to give users the option to turn the audio off entirely.

While pdfu has not yet found other screensavers with audio support, there's a good chance Apple will expand the feature to additional screensavers.

What do you think about the possibility of tvOS 27 adding audio options to Apple TV screensavers? Drop your thoughts in the comments.
